releases.new: Add st.grid for building responsive grid layouts in your app.
releases.breaking: Default theme colors, surfaces, borders and map markers changed, so apps relying on the old look may render differently; set theme values explicitly.

releases.new: Skip reruns on widget changes by passing on_change="ignore" to widgets such as st.color_picker, st.pills, and st.data_editor.
releases.breaking: Python 3.10 support is dropped; upgrade to Python 3.11 or newer before installing this release.

releases.new: Render st.dialog as a side drawer by choosing its position.
Render native Apache ECharts charts in your app with the new st.echarts_chart element.
releases.breaking: The mapbox.token config option was removed, so delete it from your config files; st.number_input now rejects inverted min/max bounds.

releases.new: Record voice input in your app with the new experimental audio input widget.
Pass Polars, Dask, Ray, xarray, Pydantic and other dataframe-like data directly to Streamlit's data display commands.
releases.breaking: Experimental cached widget replay was removed, so remove any use of it from cached functions and move widgets outside them.

releases.new: Add a feedback widget to collect thumbs or star ratings from users in your app.
releases.breaking: Deprecated experimental features and old config options were removed, including deprecation.showPyplotGlobalUse; delete those config entries and switch to the stable APIs.

releases.new: Build multipage apps with the new st.navigation and st.Page, which let you define pages and navigation in code.
releases.breaking: Legacy caching logic was removed and experimental_allow_widgets is deprecated; update cached functions that relied on the old behavior.
